scope.review_method: Manual read-only semantic inspection of every assigned question, reference and saved generated code; no dataset code executed, no targets corrected or created.

limitations: This is the assigned second half only: exactly audit_index 100..199 from each of the two fixed 200-row inspection samples. It is not an additional random draw.
All 200 assigned rows were read manually. No dataset code was executed, no source examples were modified, and no corrected/synthetic targets were written.
No concrete issue found is a bounded inspection result, not proof of reference correctness. External factual trivia was not researched.

Primary validation categories describe the most salient observable discrepancy; a row may also have a model mistake, defective reference and ambiguous statement simultaneously. The independent reference_assessment field must be retained.
Ambiguity, missing inputs, impossible integer counts and unstated rounding conventions are reported separately from clear semantic code mismatches. Some conventional readings remain defensible.
Runtime/truncation finding uses supplied status, flag and visible text; runtime was not rerun. Undefined train result is a static finding, not an observed execution.
Failure-sample category rates are conditional on selected validation failures. This half and the fixed 200-row train sample do not establish corpus-wide noise rates or exact attainable score.
Compact review inputs preserve question/reference/generated code and row identity; provenance report hashes were copied, not re-derived from remote original datasets.

interpretation.validation_reference_assessment: suspected_incorrect flags a concrete apparent question/reference mismatch on manual reading; ambiguous_or_underspecified and precision_convention are separate. These are audit judgments, not observed ground-truth error labels.
interpretation.train_counts: 18 concrete semantic reference mismatches and1 static undefined-result issue;21 statement underspecification/ambiguity/inconsistency flags;1 question prefix contamination;1 non-arithmetic trivia item;58 rows with no concrete issue found. Counts describe this100-row half only and must not be presented as proven corpus error rates.
interpretation.confidence: Confidence describes certainty of the stated observation. A high-confidence ambiguity finding does not imply confidence in a unique intended answer.
